1.explanation:
1. **src/menu/view/item.jsx**: This file likely contains the logic for rendering individual menu items, including how titles are set. The function `getTitle(children)` suggests it handles title attributes, which is central to the bug.

2. **src/menu/index.jsx**: This file imports and configures the menu components, including the `ConfigProvider`. It might be responsible for setting default behaviors or configurations related to the title attribute, which is part of the proposed solutions.
1.bug_scenario: The bug involves the automatic addition of the 'title' attribute to menu items, which causes accessibility issues and unwanted UI behavior. The title is currently added to menu items, allowing screen readers to read it and users to see the full text on hover. However, this violates WCAG guidelines when the title and innerText are identical, and some users do not want the title tooltip to appear.
